sources.entry: MyMedia - Display and watch your local movie and TV show library. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/photangralenphie/MyMedia) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: MyMedia is a SwiftUI macOS app for browsing and watching a local movie and TV show library, positioned as an alternative to Apple's TV app for local media.
summary.what_it_does: MyMedia imports media files and reads their embedded metadata to display movies and TV shows with artwork and details. It can play media in its built-in player or hand files off to the system default app. It tracks unwatched movies, shows and episodes, and lets you create collections, pin and favorite items, and keep separate genre lists for movies and TV shows. The README also describes an optional local HTTP API (no authentication) for browsing and controlling the library, with streaming, byte-range seeking, and an interactive API docs page in developer settings. The app is available in English and German.
use_cases: organize local movie collection on mac
browse TV show library with artwork
play local video files outside Apple TV app
create custom movie or show collections
stream library to another device via local API
how_to_run: Alternatively: open Releases on GitHub and download the latest MyMedia.dmg
Drag MyMedia into the Applications folder
notable: Reads metadata embedded in media files rather than a separate online database; README recommends Subler for editing metadata
Optional local HTTP API used by a MyMedia for AndroidTV app
Tracks watched state, playback progress, favorites and pinned items
Installable via Homebrew tap or DMG
caveats: Metadata cannot yet be edited inside MyMedia; planned for future
HTTP API has no authentication and should only be used on a trusted network
